bundle.shortDescription: Desktop GUI for AI-assisted coding sessions
bundle.longDescription: bot-hq drives AI-assisted coding sessions through an agent harness — role-playing participants you configure (the seeded pair executes and reviews) — with policy enforcement. Each participant runs as a claude-code subprocess coordinated by a turn ring, with an in-process MCP server for signaling, a Context Library for project knowledge, and git hooks that enforce commit and push policy.
